title: cynanchum multinerve
intro: Cynanchum multinerve, commonly known as the Chinese foxglove, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, sore throat, and cough. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum multinerve include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory and infectious diseases. The bioactive constituents of Cynanchum multinerve include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
